noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

retryable.description: Retry action if failure is a retryable c3 exception such as VersionConflict.

class.description: The class name of the native field type, parameter or return value (as marked with the "native" value type).

sourceVersion.description:
Which version of ECMAScript is required for this source code. If unspecified, it is assumed that the script is
**ES5** (lowest common denominator) and no transpilation will be done for delivery. If scripts take advantage of
later features, they must be transpiled down before being executed.

Because all method implementations for a type are in the same JavaScript file, this should be specified on the
type rather than the method declaration.

bigInt.description:
When used on a value type, the value in JavaScript will be a `BigInt` (instead of a `Number`). This is only valid
with the {@link IntType int} type (64-bit signed integer).

Note that BigInt values don't interoperate with regular numbers, so care must be taken when using them. JSON
serialization of these values must be using strings.

@see https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/BigInt
